scientific_integrity: Explicit proofs distinguish idempotent operators from idempotent matrix elements; prior inner-derivation and triangular-idempotent literature is credited. No claim of independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to K-linear associative derivations of T_n(K) with K a field and n>=2. Finite computation checks only nine small prime-field cases; algebraic proof covers arbitrary fields. Novelty risk remains from equivalences in inaccessible triangular-idempotent and derivation literature.
title: Characteristic-dependent rank spectra of idempotent derivations of triangular matrix algebras
